scope: Trial conversion and transmission on a four-dimensional archived 0PN carrier. No companion or free center. The fixed waist is the receiving boundary at w/R=0.5.
setup: Seed 1321 rested coordinates and nine original continuously registered neutral pairs per law. Common half-head n48 transit, local angular dilation. Matched noise in unforced, +0.02, -0.02, +0.01 and -0.01 copies of each of four thermal paths. Upper tagged site alone receives the applied load. At 95% order all interplane wells start at neutral strength. Compare fixed, order-proportional and order-squared binding; same-plane wells stay intact. All lower sites have initially stress-free x tethers attached to the traveling wall station. Reduced wall tension=chi(w), mass per unit arclength=1, distal impedance=sqrt(chi_end), end at order 0.0001.
measurement: Forces and times use local trial units. Positive rim force pulls in the direction of the imposed push. The signed incremental readout is half the difference of opposite drives. Cumulative rim impulse fraction at time t uses F*t as denominator. Per-step particle drag subtracts carrier transport and the applied random impulse; wall incidence, termination, storage and held support close separate ledgers. Opposite loads isolate a driven reaction above the thermal background. A 1D wall strip, patch time mapping and microscopic grip are independently uncalibrated. Relative-well survival tests original identities at every sampled time, independent of the absolute binding threshold.

"""Read out the intersection of the historically registered pairs at seed 1321."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import numpy as np


base = Path("_scratch/s11c")
archive_dir = base / "neutral_patch_material"
source_dir = archive_dir / "first_sources"
manifest = Path("research/pde_ledger_v3/_measurements/neutral_patch_sites.json")
old = json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())
digest = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
fingerprints = {str(manifest): digest(manifest.read_bytes())}
for path in (source_dir / "neutral_patch_sites.py", source_dir / "neutral_patch_hold.py"):
    fingerprints[str(path)] = digest(path.read_bytes())
    assert path.read_text() == old["replay_sources"][str(path)]
    assert fingerprints[str(path)] == old["sources"][str(path)]
for name in ("frames1321.json", "calibration.json", "predictions.json"):
    path = archive_dir / name
    fingerprints[str(path)] = digest(path.read_bytes())
    assert fingerprints[str(path)] == old["saved_measurements"][name]["sha256"]
    assert json.loads(path.read_bytes()) == old["saved_measurements"][name]["contents"]
run_key = "neutral_patch_hold1321_01"
path = base / run_key / "stdout"
fingerprints[str(path)] = digest(path.read_bytes())
assert fingerprints[str(path)] == old["runs"][run_key]["stdout_sha256"]
frames = old["saved_measurements"]["frames1321.json"]["contents"]

sys.path.insert(0, str(source_dir.resolve()))
from neutral_patch_sites import Patch, prepare


class IdProbe(Patch):
    def __init__(self, law):
        super().__init__(law)
        self.initial_strict = None
        self.surviving = None
        self.first_lost = {}
        self.samples = 0

    def neighbors(self, energy, distances, fraction):
        native = super().neighbors(energy, distances, fraction)
        if fraction == .6:
            # Reconstruct the selection by ID from its pairwise energy and
            # its row/column minima independently of native's packed edge mask.
            q = distances[self.cross].reshape(12, 12)
            v = energy[self.cross].reshape(12, 12)
            registered = (q == q.min(axis=1)[:, None]) & (q == q.min(axis=0))
            pairs = {(int(i), int(j)+12) for i, j in np.argwhere(registered & (v < -.6*.6))}
            packed = {(int(i), int(j)) for i, j in zip(self.i[native & self.cross],
                                                       self.j[native & self.cross])}
            assert pairs == packed
            if self.initial_strict is None:
                self.initial_strict = pairs.copy()
                self.surviving = pairs.copy()
            for lost in self.surviving - pairs:
                self.first_lost[lost] = self.samples
            self.surviving &= pairs
            self.samples += 1
        return native


result = {"seed": 1321, "archive_sha256": fingerprints, "laws": {}}
for law in ("central", "layered"):
    patch = IdProbe(law)
    rested, tagged_index, summary = prepare(patch, 1321)
    stored = frames[law]
    expected = np.array(stored["rested_xy"])
    actual_tag = [int(patch.i[tagged_index]), int(patch.j[tagged_index])]
    row = {"initial_strict": sorted(patch.initial_strict),
           "strict_surviving_ids": sorted(patch.surviving),
           "prior_tag": stored["sites"], "reconstructed_tag": actual_tag,
           "strict_audited_snapshots": patch.samples,
           "first_loss_snapshot": [[*k, v] for k, v in sorted(patch.first_lost.items())],
           "max_abs_rested_xy_difference": float(np.max(np.abs(rested - expected))),
           "archive_rested_float64le_sha256": digest(expected.astype("<f8").tobytes()),
           "reconstructed_rested_float64le_sha256": digest(rested.astype("<f8").tobytes())}
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    assert actual_tag == stored["sites"] and tuple(actual_tag) in patch.surviving
    assert patch.samples == 4002
    assert np.array_equal(rested, expected)
    result["laws"][law] = row
(base / "conversion_pairs_id.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+"\n")

"""Independent tests on the absolute trajectories released for the two linear laws."""
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np


base = Path("_scratch/s11c")
seed_archive = json.loads((base/"conversion_pairs_id.json").read_bytes())
frame_archive = json.loads((base/"neutral_patch_material/frames1321.json").read_bytes())
criteria = ("relative", "absolute", "one_kBT")
out = {}
for law in ("central", "layered"):
    path = base / "conversion_pair_histories" / f"{law}.npz"
    with np.load(path) as history:
        coords, times, orders = (history[key] for key in ("xy_zero", "t", "chi"))
    old = seed_archive["laws"][law]
    pairs = old["strict_surviving_ids"]
    tag = old["prior_tag"]
    rest = np.array(frame_archive[law]["rested_xy"])
    assert (coords[0] == rest-rest.mean(axis=0)).all()
    assert np.all(np.diff(times) > 0) and np.all(np.diff(orders) < 0)
    by_pair = {}
    n, ns = coords.shape[:2]
    exits = {key: np.full((ns, len(pairs)), n) for key in criteria}
    tags = None
    live_scale = orders[:, None]/orders[0]
    threshold_r = .94 - .1*np.log(1-np.sqrt(.4))
    for k, (a,b) in enumerate(pairs):
        # Distances from each partner to all competitors on the other plane.
        # Strictly closer excludes exact ties, separately checked below.
        left = np.linalg.norm(coords[:,:,a,None,:]-coords[:,:,12:,:], axis=-1)
        right = np.linalg.norm(coords[:,:,b,None,:]-coords[:,:,:12,:], axis=-1)
        sep = left[:,:,b-12].copy()
        left[:,:,b-12] = np.inf
        right[:,:,a] = np.inf
        runner_up = np.minimum(np.min(left,axis=-1),np.min(right,axis=-1))
        assert np.all(runner_up != sep)
        mutual = sep < runner_up
        radial = np.hypot(1., sep if law == "central" else sep**2)
        # Invert the Morse curve on the attractive branch for the shape test.
        # Live depth and bath thresholds use the positive absolute binding.
        relative = radial < threshold_r
        binding = .6 * live_scale * (1 - np.expm1(-10*(radial-.94))**2)
        energy_ok = {"relative":relative, "absolute": binding > .36,
                     "one_kBT": binding > .008}
        by_pair[f"{a},{b}"] = pair_data = {}
        for key, deep in energy_ok.items():
            valid = deep & mutual
            if [a,b] == tag and key == "relative":
                tags = valid.copy()
            firsts = []
            for s in range(ns):
                failures = np.flatnonzero(~valid[:,s])
                if failures.size:
                    j = int(failures[0])
                    exits[key][s,k] = j
                    firsts.append({"step":j,"t":float(times[j]),"chi":float(orders[j]),
                        "energy_passed":bool(deep[j,s]),"mutual":bool(mutual[j,s]),
                        "current_at_end":bool(valid[-1,s])})
                else:
                    firsts.append(None)
            pair_data[key] = firsts
    log = base / f"converting_{law}_p1_01/stdout"
    primary = [json.loads(line) for line in log.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert primary[0]["pairs"] == pairs and primary[0]["tag"] == tag
    rows = []
    for r in (row for row in primary if row["test"] == "crossing"):
        j, = np.flatnonzero(times == r["t"])
        assert orders[j] == r["chi"]
        surviving = exits["relative"] > j
        indices = [np.flatnonzero(v).tolist() for v in surviving]
        counts = {key:(exits[key] > j).sum(axis=1).tolist() for key in criteria}
        assert indices == r["strict_zero_ids"] and counts["absolute"] == r["absolute_zero_count"]
        assert tags[j].tolist() == r["unforced_tag_current"]
        assert surviving[:,pairs.index(tag)].tolist() == [item[0] for item in r["loaded_tag_continuous"]]
        rows.append({"chi":float(orders[j]),"strict_ids_by_seed":[[pairs[i] for i in s] for s in indices],
                     "counts": counts})
    printed_first = primary[-1]["unforced_by_seed_and_original_pair"]
    computed_first = [[float(orders[j]) if j < n else None for j in seed] for seed in exits["relative"]]
    assert computed_first == printed_first
    last_abs = orders[exits["absolute"]]
    summaries = {"absolute_first_per_seed":last_abs.max(axis=1).tolist(),
        "absolute_last_per_seed":last_abs.min(axis=1).tolist(),
        "geometric_losses_at_first_relative_exit":
        sum(event is not None and not event["mutual"] for record in by_pair.values()
            for event in record["relative"]),
        "insufficient_energy_at_first_relative_exit":
        sum(event is not None and not event["energy_passed"] for record in by_pair.values()
            for event in record["relative"])}
    out[law] = {"history_sha256":sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "primary_stdout_sha256":sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "frames":n,"seeds":primary[0]["seeds"],"prior_tag":tag,
                "gates":rows, "first_exit_by_pair_and_seed":by_pair,"summary":summaries}
    print(json.dumps({"law":law,"frames":n,
        "gate_counts":[[row["chi"],row["counts"]] for row in rows],**summaries,
        "tag_first_exit":by_pair[",".join(map(str,tag))]}),flush=True)
(base/"conversion_pairs_id_history.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+"\n")

"""Independent moving point-force wall replay and uniform continuum gauge test."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.sparse.linalg import factorized

BASE = Path("_scratch/s11c")

def emit(name, **data):
    print(json.dumps({"test": name, **data}), flush=True)

def matrices(k):
    n = len(k)
    incidence = sparse.diags([np.ones(n), -np.ones(n-1)], [0, -1], shape=(n,n), format="csc")
    return (incidence.T @ sparse.diags(k) @ incidence).tocsc(), incidence

def replay(t, k, m, z, station, mix, port, implicit):
    K, G = matrices(k)
    n, d = len(k), port.shape[1]
    u = np.zeros((n,d))
    v = np.zeros_like(u)
    m = m[1:]
    external = np.zeros_like(u)
    cache = {}
    rim = np.zeros_like(port)
    impulse = np.zeros(d)
    outgoing = np.zeros(d)
    work = np.zeros(d)
    heat = np.zeros(d)
    for j,h in enumerate(np.diff(t)):
        a = station[j]-1
        external.fill(0)
        external[a] += (1-mix[j])*port[j]
        external[a+1] += mix[j]*port[j]
        elastic = K @ u
        if implicit:
            interval = round(h,13)
            if interval not in cache:
                diagonal = m.copy()
                diagonal[-1] += h*z/2
                cache[interval] = factorized((sparse.diags(diagonal,format="csc")+h*h/4*K).tocsc())
            mid_v = cache[interval](m[:,None]*v + h/2*(external-elastic))
            next_v = 2*mid_v-v
            next_u = u+h*mid_v
            sample = k[0]*(next_u[0]+u[0])/2
            outgoing += h*z*mid_v[-1]
            work += h*np.sum(external*mid_v,axis=0)
            heat += h*z*mid_v[-1]**2
        else:
            residual = external-elastic
            residual[-1] -= z*v[-1]
            next_v = v + h/m[:,None]*residual
            next_u = u+h*next_v
            sample = k[0]*u[0]
            outgoing += h*z*v[-1]
        impulse += h*sample
        rim[j+1] = k[0]*next_u[0]
        u,v = next_u,next_v
    stored = .5*(np.sum(m[:,None]*v**2,axis=0)+np.sum(k[:,None]*(G@u)**2,axis=0))
    momentum = m @ v
    return dict(rim=rim, impulse=impulse, outgoing=outgoing, endpoint_shift=z*u[-1],
                work=work, heat=heat, stored=stored, momentum=momentum)

def odd(a): return (a[...,1]-a[...,2])/2

def moving(law):
    p = BASE / "conversion_pair_histories" / (law+".npz")
    with np.load(p) as raw:
        t,k,m,z,s,b,port,rim = [raw[key] for key in ["t","k","mass","Z","station","mix","port","rim"]]
    last = [r for raw in (BASE / ("converting_"+law+"_p1_01") / "stdout").read_text().splitlines()
            if (r:=json.loads(raw)).get("test")=="crossing"][-1]
    assert t[-1] == last["t"]
    args = t,k,m,z,s,b,port
    primary = replay(*args,implicit=False)
    other = replay(*args,implicit=True)
    applied = np.sum(np.diff(t,axis=0)[:,None]*port[:-1],axis=0)
    maxabs = lambda a: float(np.max(np.abs(a)))
    original = dict(rim_impulse=primary["impulse"],end_impulse=primary["outgoing"],
                    line_momentum=primary["momentum"],port_impulse=applied)
    recorded_discrepancy = {key:maxabs(value-np.array(last[key][0])) for key,value in original.items()}
    force_amplitude = maxabs(odd(rim))
    single_drive = .02*t[-1]
    emit("moving_replay",law=law,t_stop=float(t[-1]),all_drive_force_error=maxabs(primary["rim"]-rim),
         original_final_errors=recorded_discrepancy,
         midpoint_force_error_on_odd=maxabs(odd(other["rim"]-rim)),
         peak_odd_rim=force_amplitude,
         primary_odd_rim_impulse=float(odd(primary["impulse"])),other_odd_rim_impulse=float(odd(other["impulse"])),
         primary_ratio=float(odd(primary["impulse"])/single_drive),other_ratio=float(odd(other["impulse"])/single_drive),
         midpoint_odd_port=float(odd(applied)),midpoint_odd_distal=float(odd(other["outgoing"])),
         midpoint_odd_line_momentum=float(odd(other["momentum"])),
         midpoint_momentum_residual=maxabs(applied-other["impulse"]-other["outgoing"]-other["momentum"]),
         midpoint_dashpot_residual=maxabs(other["outgoing"]-other["endpoint_shift"]),
         midpoint_energy_residual=maxabs(other["work"]-other["heat"]-other["stored"]),
         midpoint_terminal_heat=other["heat"].tolist(),midpoint_input_work=other["work"].tolist())
    assert maxabs(primary["rim"]-rim)<1e-10 and max(recorded_discrepancy.values())<1e-10
    assert maxabs(applied-other["impulse"]-other["outgoing"]-other["momentum"])<1e-9
    assert maxabs(other["work"]-other["heat"]-other["stored"])<1e-9
    assert maxabs(other["outgoing"]-other["endpoint_shift"])<1e-10

def uniform(n):
    dx=2/n
    k=np.full(n,1/dx)
    mass=np.full(n+1,dx)
    mass[[0,-1]] /= 2
    t=np.linspace(0.,4.8,9601)
    delay=.5
    def pulse(times):
        return np.sin(np.pi*np.clip(times/.5,0,1))**4
    port=pulse((t+np.r_[t[1:],t[-1]])/2)[:,None]
    case=replay(t,k,mass,1.,np.full(len(t),round(delay/dx),dtype=int),np.zeros(len(t)),port,True)
    exact=pulse(t-delay)
    read=case["rim"][:,0]
    err=float(np.max(abs(read-exact)))
    emit("uniform",n=n,delay=delay,peak_error=err,peak_time=float(t[np.argmax(read)]),
         peak=float(max(read)),negative_min=float(min(read)),rim_impulse=float(case["impulse"][0]),
         incident_impulse=float(np.diff(t)@port[:-1,0]),distal_net_impulse=float(case["outgoing"][0]),
         remaining_momentum=float(case["momentum"][0]),input_work=float(case["work"][0]),
         dissipated=float(case["heat"][0]),remaining_energy=float(case["stored"][0]))
    assert abs(case["impulse"][0]-.1875)<1e-4
    assert abs(case["work"][0]-case["heat"][0]-case["stored"][0])<1e-10
    return err

for law in ["central","layered"]:
    moving(law)
a,b=uniform(160),uniform(320)
assert b<a and b<.005
